name: ATS Shredder
hook: Hand your paper resume to the boss before the recruitment AI auto-bins you
tagline: A student desperately hands over a paper CV across a checkout counter while robotic ATS scanners fire rejection laser beams. Cashing out locks in a firm handshake and a store badge before the portal triggers. Crashing delivers a three-minute automated regret email directly to your pocket with buzzing red sirens.
